description:
Voice model option "speechmatics:voice-id": Speechmatics recognizes saved people itself, live and in batch, instead of local embeddings + decideMatch.

Storage/identity (packages/pipeline/src/identity-service.ts, packages/domain/src/identity.ts):
- New embeddingSpace "speechmatics-id@<model version>". A VoiceProfile in that space holds sealed Speechmatics identifiers (new row type or sealed JSON in VoicePrototype.sealedVector; decide in impl) with source recording and createdAt.
- Enrollment: when the user names a cluster from a Speechmatics recording (assign/learnVoice), take that provider label's identifiers from SpeakersResult (live: requested with get_speakers at stream end, persisted per run keyed by scoped label; batch: from the job result) and store them on the person's profile. Undo, merge, forgetVoice, and "Learn this voice" off all apply to identifiers.
- Identification: at session/job start send speakers [{label: <opaque personId token, never the name>, speaker_identifiers}] within the 50-identifier budget (most recent/highest-evidence per person; exclude needsReenrollment). AddTranscript labels that match a person token -> coordinator emits an accepted MatchDecision (source "service") so glasses show the name live (kdl.16/17 path) and hideOwnSpeechOnGlasses works for selfPersonId.
- Model version change or identifiers rejected -> profiles needsReenrollment; re-enroll from kept voice clips (keepVoiceClips) via batch get_speakers, mirroring migrateEmbeddingSpace.
- Match tuning (kdl.18 panel): for this space show speakers_sensitivity instead of score sliders; readout shows service-assigned labels.
- Resolver: option requires Speechmatics in stt-live or stt-final and a key; selecting it triggers the voiceprint consent (identifiers stored by Speechmatics). Switching voice model to/from it uses the existing re-enroll confirm in SettingsView setModel.
- plan.md §6/§10 and the app.json permission description updated for cloud voiceprints.

Done when: name a speaker once in a Speechmatics recording; next Speechmatics recording names them live on the glasses and in the final transcript without local embeddings; forget voice removes identifiers so they're no longer sent.
title: Speechmatics voice identification: enroll identifiers and name known speakers live and in batch
